{:.intro-paragraph}
This project will explore **how collaborative data visualization environments can enable diverse audiences to address wicked problems**. Addressing wicked societal problems without clear definitions or solutions---such as climate change mitigation, peacebuilding, and social inequalities---requires collaboration among people with varied expertise and interests, including researchers, policymakers, business leaders, educators, and citizens. By working together, these groups can better understand the problems and co-create potential solutions. 


<br>

CollEcTIVE aims to **empower people to collaboratively tackle wicked problems using innovative data visualization environments**. 
- We *study how people collaborate with data* and how such collaboration enhances understanding, learning, and problem-solving. 
- We *design, develop, and evaluate user interfaces* that support collaborative data-centered activities, including data collection and sharing, exploration and visualization of complex datasets, communication of findings, deliberation, and communicating solutions.

<br>

# Consortium
**[Bivwac](https://bivwac.fr)** is a joint-research team at the [Inria centre at the University of Bordeaux](https://www.inria.fr/en/inria-centre-university-bordeaux) and CNRS (LaBRI). It studies new forms of immersive and interactive visualization experiences that aim to improve the understanding of complex data and phenomena. Its goal is to provide tools that help transmit and advance knowledge in order to promote the construction of a sustainable and desirable future.
